scope: Approved FunctionalRevision02 neutral 3D assembly and retained A preservation only

criteria.name: Hall scale and retained A hierarchy
criteria.finding: 60 x 24 x 18 m datums; 107 retained actor records unchanged; portal, beams and setbacks remain readable.

criteria.name: Four rooms, terminal closure and roofs
criteria.finding: Four rooms close terminal aisles; correct stepped roof contacts. Inner rear trim is outside the closed room envelope; actual 2 cm retained band is distinguished from author 3 cm prose.

criteria.finding: Four correctly faced closed doors; 1.2 x 2.4 m clear frame, 0.24 m recess, 0.06 m leaves, flush thresholds and actual contacts.

criteria.finding: Four 2.4-square shafts at X +/-12.6 / Y +/-2.4 meet Z18 ceiling over full sections; 2.4/2.0 m gaps and unchanged strips.

criteria.name: Checkpoint walking lanes
criteria.finding: Exactly two 1.5 m ground-level openings at the 11.2 m joined control line; actual passage both ways and terminal blocking. No security/anti-jump claim.

criteria.name: Elevator and opaque inner wall
criteria.finding: Single 3.6 x 4.2 m opening, 0.6 m reveal, closed leaves and blank opaque upper wall; superseded glazing/grid absent.

criteria.name: Depth and coherent joins
criteria.finding: Neutral views expose real reveals, returns, soffits and setbacks. No unresolved visible geometry failure; inner seams assessed as retained facing/rear cavities.

criteria.name: Image quality and comparable camera evidence
criteria.finding: 13 native 1920 x 1080 captures, actual HFOV90 and matching map metadata; all four approved sheet-05 poses matched.

criteria.name: Real input-driven runtime movement
criteria.finding: 115 events/2041 samples full run plus 11 events/226 samples final elevator recheck; required routes, contacts, possession, look, grounding, jump and landing covered.

criteria.name: Saved source/imports, identity, preservation and restoration
criteria.finding: 17 native/imported modules, 20 assemblies, verified hashes and protected bytes; recorded final candidate clean and PIE stopped with restored settings.

nonblocking_notes.observed: Actual retained InnerEndBand bounds are X29.97..29.99 (2 cm), while worker prose calls them 3 cm.
nonblocking_notes.consequence: Author wording overstates rear fill. Component-level audit establishes a closed room at the band front, with a rear cavity outside the enclosure; no room leak or walking bypass.
nonblocking_notes.smallest_followup: Clarify the dimension in a future mutable handoff; do not alter frozen candidate evidence.

nonblocking_notes.observed: Inner shell module length is 10.17 m after a concealed 0.03 m rear trim; the schedule report uses literal gross assembly length 10.2 m.
nonblocking_notes.consequence: That row is an assembly datum, not independent measured shell length. The room-side plane and visible/functional dimensions remain within scope and tolerance.
nonblocking_notes.smallest_followup: Keep measured component lengths distinct from overall assembly datums in future reporting.

limitations: Read-only review of recorded editor/DCC/runtime evidence; no new live editor query, DCC operation or PIE run.
